nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used as the onlyOwner access-control anchor.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
TokenBEP20.newun: locked recipient address used as a transfer gate / honeypot switch in transfer and transferFrom.
TokenBEP20.balances: mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, credited in the constructor and mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
TokenBEP20.allowed: nested allowance mapping, written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
TokenBEP20._totalSupply: fixed 1e21 token supply minted to the owner in the constructor.
TokenBEP20.symbol = "BSC".
TokenBEP20.name = "BSC | t.me/BSCXcoin".
TokenBEP20.decimals = 18.
SafeMath.add(uint,uint): checked addition with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub(uint,uint): checked subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul(uint,uint): checked multiplication with division overflow guard.
SafeMath.div(uint,uint): division with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner: stages newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, moves ownership.
TokenBEP20 constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply to owner.
TokenBEP20.transfernewun(address) onlyOwner: sets the locked recipient (honeypot switch).
TokenBEP20.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
TokenBEP20.balanceOf(address): returns balances[tokenOwner].
TokenBEP20.transfer(address,uint): blocks transfers to newun, moves balances with SafeMath.
TokenBEP20.approve(address,uint): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender].
TokenBEP20.transferFrom(address,address,uint): allowance-based transfer with newun honeypot logic, mutates balances and allowed.
TokenBEP20.allowance(address,address): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
TokenBEP20.approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes): sets allowance then performs an external call to the spender.
TokenBEP20 fallback: external payable that always reverts.
BSC.clearCNDAO() onlyOwner: sends the whole contract ETH balance to msg.sender.
BSC fallback: external payable, accepts ETH with empty body.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used as owner, sender, spender, allowance key and ETH recipient.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed during approveAndCall without any reentrancy guard.
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance) ETH value transfer in clearCNDAO, executed before any state finalization.
parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
parameter _newun of transfernewun.
parameter to of transfer.
parameter tokens of transfer.
parameter spender of approve.
parameter tokens of approve.
parameter from of transferFrom.
parameter to of transferFrom.
parameter tokens of transferFrom.
parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
parameter spender of allowance.
parameter spender of approveAndCall, also the external callee address.
parameter tokens of approveAndCall.
parameter data of approveAndCall, forwarded verbatim to the callee.
local variable _owner (address payable) in clearCNDAO, aliasing msg.sender.

edges.reason: msg.sender provides the value stored as owner inside the Owned constructor.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner to gate transferOwnership.
parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before granting ownership.
acceptOwnership sets owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
TokenBEP20 constructor inherits owner from msg.sender.
constructor assigns _totalSupply = 1000000000000 * 10**9.
constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole supply.
transfernewun is protected by onlyOwner, privilege comes from msg.sender.
parameter _newun is assigned to the newun state variable.
transfernewun writes the newun lock address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the subtraction.
parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
msg.sender is the debited sender account in transfer.
parameter to is the credited recipient in transfer.
parameter tokens is the amount debited/credited in transfer.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transfer delegates subtraction/addition to SafeMath.sub and SafeMath.add.
parameter spender is the allowance key in approve.
parameter tokens is the allowance value in approve.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance entry in approve.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender].
parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
parameter tokens is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and can silently set the newun lock, gating who may receive tokens.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub/add for balance and allowance math.
parameter tokenOwner indexes the outer allowance mapping.
parameter spender indexes the inner allowance mapping.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
msg.sender is used as the owner key and as the forwarded approval sender in approveAndCall.
parameter spender is both the allowance key and the external callee in approveAndCall.
parameter tokens is written into the allowance and forwarded to the callee.
parameter data is forwarded verbatim to the external callee.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an attacker-controlled external call before returning.
msg.sender is passed to the untrusted callee and can drive reentrant behaviour.
The callee invoked by receiveApproval can call back into approveAndCall/transferFrom with the freshly granted allowance.
clearCNDAO is onlyOwner; privileged fund extraction is authorised by msg.sender.
local _owner aliases msg.sender and receives the contract balance.
clearCNDAO transfers the full ETH balance via _owner.transfer.
msg.sender is the ETH recipient, so an attacker-controlled address receives funds mid-function.
The receiving payable fallback executes while clearCNDAO has not yet completed, enabling reentrant draining.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter only feeds the newOwner state variable written by transferOwnership, so it collapses into that function node.
The _newun parameter exists solely to set the newun lock inside transfernewun and adds no independent semantics.
The to parameter is only the destination used by transfer's balance update and can be folded into the function node.
The tokens parameter is only the SafeMath amount consumed by transfer.
The spender parameter is only the allowance key written by approve.
The tokens parameter is only the allowance value written by approve.
The from parameter is only the debited account read/written by transferFrom.
The to parameter is only the credited account written by transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is only the SafeMath amount and allowance delta used by transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is only the mapping key of a single read in balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter is only the outer mapping key read by allowance.
The spender parameter is only the inner mapping key read by allowance.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external callee inside approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is only the allowance amount forwarded to the callee by approveAndCall.
The data parameter is only an opaque blob forwarded to the external callee in approveAndCall.
The local _owner is a direct alias of msg.sender inside clearCNDAO and carries no separate meaning.
